## Existing-flow fixes

Unchanged completed-worker reports are no longer repeated while other workers run. Revised final text remains visible even when its message ID is unchanged. Errors and undrained evidence remain actionable. Report pages fill the existing 4 KiB budget rather than repeatedly halving it. Source-page fitting no longer serializes the entire remaining file, but still verifies its full hash. No new role, mode, Hook or model call; permissions, model/effort policy and acceptance stay unchanged. These are tested transport/Reader improvements, not measured whole-task token or quality gains.

## 现有流程修复

等待其他执行者时，不再反复返回已经读过且未变化的完成报告；同一消息 ID 的正文被修正时仍显示为新证据。错误和未读完的证据不会被隐藏。报告分页充分利用原有 4 KiB 容量，不再反复折半；源码分页不再为截取一页而序列化整个剩余文件，但仍验证完整哈希。不新增角色、模式、Hook 或模型调用，权限、模型档位与验收标准不变。测试证明的是工具传输与 Reader 的改进，不代表已测得完整任务的 token、速度或质量收益。

## Unreleased existing-flow fixes

- Suppress unchanged completed reports while detecting revised final text and preserving errors.
- Fill bounded report pages and cap serialization candidates without weakening full source checks.
- Add regressions for evidence delivery, Unicode pagination, stale cursors and read bounds.
- No roles, modes, services or permission changes; no live-model savings claim.
